import sys

def main():
    str_input = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip('\n')
    result = 0
    i = 0
    while i < len(str_input):
        j = i + 1
        while j < len(str_input) and str_input[i] == str_input[j]:
            j += 1
        result += (j - i + 1) % 2
        i = j
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
